select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.issue_price issuePrice, fpd.issue_amt issueAmt, fpd.issue_Type issueType, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, fpd.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, '' investType, '' raiseType, to_char(fpd.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(fpd.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate,
to_char(fpd.actmdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') actmdate, to_char(fpd.LIQUIDATION_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') liquidationDate, (fpd.MDATE-fpd.VDATE+1) term, 'A/365' basis, ext.sale_period salePeriod, case when nvl(ext.sale_layer,0)!=0 then 'Y' else 'N' end isSaleLayer, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION isReconciliation, ext.CREATE_ORG createOrg, ext.VAL_ORG valOrg, mci1.CUSTOMER_NAME createOrgName, mci2.CUSTOMER_NAME valOrgName, ext.IS_CYCLE isCycle, ext.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, ext.PROFIT_FLAG profitFlag, fpd.p_Finprod_Id pFinprodId, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, SUM(amt.trade_amt) planraiseAmt, decode(bbext.PARAM_VALUE,'Y','true','false') isTrustCurrent, fpd.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, C.CALENDAR_NAME AS calendarName, pvp.UNITVALUE_DEC AS unitvalueDec, /* 单位净值小数位 */ pvp.UNITVALUE_MODE AS unitvalueMode, /* 单位净值尾数处理方式 */ pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC AS milionProfitDec, /* 万份收益小数位 */ pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC_MODE AS milionProfitDecMode, /* 万份收益尾数处理方式 */ pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC AS yearYieldDec, /* 年化收益率小数位 */ pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC_MODE AS yearYieldDecMode, /* 年化收益率尾数处理方式 */ pvp.IS_COUNTING_CUR_INT AS isCountingCurInt /* 是否计提活期利息 */ from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join FIN_PRODUCT_add ext on fpd.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci1 on ext.CREATE_ORG = mci1.CUSTOMER_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci2 on ext.VAL_ORG = mci2.CUSTOMER_ID left join ( select sum(tpd.trade_amt) trade_amt,tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where 1=1 AND (tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF16} or tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF55}) group by tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date )amt on fpd.finprod_id = amt.finprod_id and amt.settle_date = fpd.VDATE LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO C ON C.CALENDAR_ID = fpd.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbext ON bbext.BOOKSET_ID = fpd.finprod_id AND bbext.PARAM_CODE = 'PRD_IS_CALC' LEFT JOIN PRD_VAL_PARAM pvp ON pvp.FINPROD_ID = fpd.finprod_id where (fpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF16} or fpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF55}) AND (fpd.profit_type = #{profitType01} or fpd.profit_type = #{profitType03})
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND fpd.profit_Type in
#{profitType}
AND fpd.OPERATION_TYPE in
#{operationType}
AND fpd.FINPROD_id in
#{finprodId}
AND fpd.VDATE >=to_date(#{vdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.VDATE <=to_date(#{vdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE >=to_date(#{mdateStart},'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND fpd.mDATE <=to_date(#{mdateEnd},'yyyy-MM-dd')
group by fpd.finprod_id , fpd.finprod_abbr , fpd.finprod_name , fpd.FINPROD_TYPE , fpd.profit_type , fpd.issue_price , fpd.issue_amt , fpd.issue_Type , fpd.CCY , fpd.OPERATION_TYPE, fpd.TRUSTEE_ID, fpd.VDATE , fpd.MDATE , fpd.LIQUIDATION_DATE, fpd.actmdate, ext.sale_period , ext.sale_layer, ext.profit_flag, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION, ext.CREATE_ORG, ext.VAL_ORG, mci1.CUSTOMER_NAME, mci2.CUSTOMER_NAME, ext.IS_CYCLE, ext.PROD_REGIST_CODE, ext.PROFIT_FLAG, fpd.p_Finprod_Id , fpd.is_chl , fpd.is_sus , fpd.is_right , bbext.PARAM_VALUE, fpd.CALENDAR_ID , C.CALENDAR_NAME, pvp.UNITVALUE_DEC, pvp.UNITVALUE_MODE, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC_MODE, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC_MODE, pvp.IS_COUNTING_CUR_INT order by fpd.VDATE desc,fpd.profit_type

select prd.finprod_id id, nvl(prd.finprod_abbr,prd.finprod_name) text from fin_product prd where 1=1
AND prd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (prd.finprod_id like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR prd.finprod_abbr like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR prd.finprod_name like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))
order by prd.finprod_id

select distinct info.acct_name id, info.acct_name text from Stl_Fin_Product_Acct acct left join stl_capacct_info info on acct.acct_no = info.acct_no where 1=1
and info.acct_name = #{acctName}

SELECT A.PARAM_CODE AS paramCode, A.PARAM_VALUE AS paramValue FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT A LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND C.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} WHERE C.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT PARAM_VALUE AS paramValue FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT WHERE PARAM_CODE=#{paramCode} and BOOKSET_ID = #{finprodId} and rownum=1

SELECT JS.ACCTID acctId,--编号（内部ID） JS.ACCTCODE acctCode, --账户名称 JB.BROKERNAME brokerName, --所属券商 JS.ACCTDESC acctDesc,--账户描述 JBCA.BANKDESC bankDesc --关联资金账户 FROM JXB_SECACCT JS JOIN JXS_PORTFOLIO_HDR JPH ON JPH.PORTFOLIO = JS.PORTFOLIO JOIN JXS_BROKER JB ON JB.BROKERID = JS.BROKERCODE JOIN JXB_BK_CASH_ACCT JBCA ON JBCA.BK_ACCT_NO = JS.DEFAULTCASHACCT
AND JPH.SHORTCODE = #{finprodId}
select vbb.acct_subject_id from bok_bookset vbb left join bok_bookset_date bbd on vbb.bookset_id = bbd.bookset_id where vbb.acct_subject_id = #{finprodId} and bbd.bookset_date > vbb.start_date
